puzzles.description: Review the HKEX circular — answer each question to identify the key facts.

questions.question:
HKEX/RC-2026-017 — how many chapters are amended?

Effective: 12 May 2026
Chapters Amended: 3
• Ch.13 Continuing Obligations
• Ch.14 Notifiable Transactions
• Ch.37 Debt Securities

Key Changes:
1. Enhanced disclosure format for connected transactions
2. Updated e-Filing system integration
3. Record-keeping period extended from 3 to 5 years
4. Mandatory breach escalation within 2 business days
What is the effective date of the amendments?
What is the new record-keeping period?
What is the mandatory breach escalation window?

hints: Read the circular title carefully — it mentions the number of chapters.
The circular says: 3 chapters, effective 12 May, record-keeping extended to 5 years, escalation within 2 days.
